help.header.body: Box of the (i) button in the header: free, open source, no data uploaded, version in progress, address for suggestions (three paragraphs, only these); {app} = program name.
header.about: Title and alternative text of the "i" button at the top right; {app} = program name.
files.row.remove: Label and tooltip of the × on a file row of the file list; {name} = the label of the file it removes.
files.ctx.removeShown: Entry of the file row menu that removes every ticked (shown) file at once; {n} = how many.
files.removeAll.what: What the "Removed · Undo" notice names after "Removed:" when the "remove all files" button of the file list took out {n} files at once.
files.prec.row: Label of a precursor row under a product-ion (MS2) file in the file list; {mz} = the precursor m/z.
files.drop.mixed: Note after a drop on the file list: {m} files left unopened because their resolution (low/high) differs from the open files.
files.color.of: Title of the color picker; {label} = sample name (already escaped).
files.color.swatch: Accessible name of a color swatch; {c} = hexadecimal color code.
files.group.ms2: Name of the group of product-ion files (high resolution) in the file list; {ms} = levels present (MS2, MS3 or MS2/MS3).
fondo.auto.text: {w} = width of the SNIP window, in min.
corr.flat: Entry of the "Subtract the background" menu: the background is the flattest window of the run.
fondo.flat.chip: Label above the chart; {ranges} = ends of the window (min), {levels} = level in cps.
fondo.flat.auto: In parentheses after the label: the window is the one chosen by the program (feminine).
fondo.flat.mod: In parentheses after the label: the window was moved by the user (feminine).
fondo.flat.left: Tooltip and accessible name of the ◀ button.
fondo.flat.right: Tooltip and accessible name of the ▶ button.
fondo.flat.restore: Button that goes back to the automatic window; it appears only after a move.
fondo.flat.aria: Accessible name of the label; {state} = automatic / modified by you, {ranges} = ends.
fondo.flat.none: Notice when the trace is too short to look for the window.
ibk.yes: Description of the background of a segment (legend, Excel, images); {ranges} = time intervals, {stat} = mean/median/line, {clip} = ", negatives set to 0" or empty.
ibk.and: Two time intervals of the straight-line background: "0-1 min and 5-6 min".
lst.tgt.row.tip: {rt} is the retention time of the peak, in minutes.
ibk.chip.title: The name "automatic baseline" is corr.snip.
ibk.chip: Label next to the chart; {ranges} = intervals, {levels} = level(s) in cps, {stat} = mean/median/line.
ibk.first: The quoted name is the right-click menu entry (ctx.ibk.line).
ibk.leg: Chip in the legend above the chart that says which segment is the internal blank and its level; {ranges} = interval(s) in min, {level} = level with unit (for example 2.70e8 cps).
leg.traces: Label of the collapsed legend; {n} = number of traces.
leg.note.mz: Note below the legend of a filtered TIC; {lo} and {hi} = m/z ends (or "min"/"max").
leg.note.prec: Note below the legend; {prec} = precursor m/z.
leg.note.corr: Note below the legend; {corr} = corrections applied (e.g. "- internal blank").
leg.note.rowScale: Note below the legend of the stacked charts; {h} = height of a row in cps.
int.base.pt: Accessible name of one of the two points of a custom baseline (button to drag with mouse, finger or pen, or to move with the arrow keys); {n} = 1 or 2, {rt} = time in minutes, {y} = intensity.
grad.src.dam: Origin of the gradient shown in the Method window.
gradient.err.point: Error of a gradient point; {t} = time, {b} = %B.
gradient.err.order: Error of the gradient CSV; {line} = line number.
gradient.err.row: Error of the gradient CSV; {line} = line number.
gradient.err.bRange: Error of the gradient CSV; {line} = line number.
grad.legend.one: Note at the top right of the chromatogram; {file} = file whose gradient is shown.
grad.read: Reading next to the gradient curve; {t} = time, {b} = %B (or "programmed / at the column").
grad.read.cursor: Part of the cursor reading; {b} = %B at the cursor time.
lr.mirror.desc: Description read by screen readers; {n} experimental peaks, {m} from the library, {name} entry name.
iso.note: Legend of the spectrum with the isotope profile; {formula} and {adduct} in HTML, {align} = following box.
iso.noPeak: Sentence added to the isotope profile line when the spectrum has no peak near the expected value; {mz} = expected m/z.
iso.shift: Part of a sentence about the isotope profile: m/z shift of the profile; the placeholder is the already formatted value.
files.ugrp.name: Name given at once to a new user group of the side file list (renamed later by the user); {n} = 1, 2, ... the first number not in use.
files.ugrp.toggle: Accessible name of the fold button of a user group header in the side file list; {g} = the group name.
help.start.body: Help text (guide) for the student; contains HTML. The names in quotation marks are interface labels: render them as in lang/en.js.
lst.compatible: Header row of the box that opens on the peak (high resolution).
lst.cut: Above the lists table: the table shows only the first n entries out of m; n and m are numbers.
lst.more: In the peak box: how many other compatible entries are not shown.
lst.user.of: Value of the "source" and "license" fields of the lists written by the user.
lst.textMore: Tail of the sentence listing the contaminants compatible with a formula; {n} = how many more.
lst.askAdd: Question with a text field; {mz} = value with 4 decimals.
lst.lab.empty: The quoted names are the right-click menu entry (ctx...) and the lst.lab.add button.
lst.lab.importedCut: Message after importing a contaminants CSV longer than the cap: {max} = rows taken, {m} = rows in the file, {rest} = rows left out; it states the next step.
lst.lab.imported: Message after importing a CSV; {n} = number of rows.
lst.member: Tooltip on a row of a homologous series (e.g. PEG); {n} = number of repeating units (monomers) in the chain.
lst.unitName.one: Name of a row of a homologous series with a single repeating unit; {name} = name of the substance.
lst.unitName.many: As above with several repeating units; {n} = number of units, {name} = name of the substance.
lst.unitShort.one: "Series / Unit" column of the list, a single repeating unit.
lst.unitShort.many: "Series / Unit" column of the list; {n} = number of repeating units.
hr.notice: Temporary notice at the bottom; {files} = file names.
hr.iso.widthDef: Peak width in the isotope profile legend; {def} = percentage of the height at which it is measured.
hr.iso.res: Resolution in the isotope profile legend.
hr.iso.legend: Entry of the legend below the spectrum; {formula} and {adduct} = already formatted HTML, {w} = width/resolution (with a leading space or empty), {obs} = observed offset or the hr.iso.noPeak sentence.
hr.iso.width: Peak width in the isotope profile legend; {v} = value, {unit} = ppm or Da.
feat.err.lines: Error below the ion list. {n} = invalid lines, {list} = numbers of the first lines.
feat.err.many: Error: list too long, not measured. {n} = ions in the list, {max} = maximum number of ions at a time.
feat.sum: Summary of the table. {n} = features, {m} = files, {src} = origin (sentence).
feat.unmatched: Warning. {list} = names of the files without a column.
feat.more: Note below the preview. {n} = features not shown.
feat.row.aria: Accessible label of a table row. {mz} = m/z, {rt} = RT.
kmd.axis.km: Title of the x axis of the KMD chart. {unit} = repeating unit (CF2, CH2...).
kmd.more: Note below the ions table. {n} = rows shown, {m} = total rows.
kmd.noseries: Message when no series reaches the minimum. {min} = minimum members, {tol} = KMD window in mDa.
kmd.plot.aria: Accessible description of the KMD chart. {unit} = repeating unit, {n} = ions, {s} = candidate series.
kmd.point.tip: Tooltip of a point of the KMD chart. {mz} = m/z, {rt} = RT, {kmd} = KMD, {s} = series number or a dash.
kmd.row.aria: Accessible label of a row or of a point. {mz} = m/z, {rt} = RT.
kmd.series.aria: Accessible label of a row of the series table. {n} = series number, {m} = members.
kmd.sum: Summary above the KMD chart. {n} = ions, {s} = candidate series, {k} = ions in a series, {unit} = repeating unit.
fondo.chip.auto: Label of the automatic background below the chart. {min} and {max} = minimum and maximum of the removed baseline, in cps (already formatted).
inf.skip: Tooltip of a row of the precursor tree: how many generations are missing between the node and its parent ({n}).
llm.consent.state: Row of the assistant settings; {n} = number of providers the user has given consent for.
llm.consenso.where: Consent window; {host} = name of the external service the requests would go to (e.g. a model provider).
llm.consenso.where.local: Consent window for a local model; {host} = address on the user's computer (e.g. localhost:11434).
llm.consenso.cost.price: Model price per million tokens; {in} = input, {out} = output, {cur} = currency, {date} = price date.
llm.spend: Demo spending counter in the panel; {spent} = spent, {cap} = cap, in dollars with two decimals.
files.up.opening: Progress row of the side list: the file is read and about to open.
files.up.cancel: × of a progress row: stops reading that file; {name} = file name.
files.up.close: × of a failed progress row: removes the row; {name} = file name.
